name: account_labels_20261023
comment: ANCHOR: ACCOUNT_LABELS_20261023 — every Command Center position / trade row names its account (operator 2026-10-23:
"two SpaceX and two different accounts" / "just a name, not the account numbers"). config/account_display_names.json
names are digit-free and unique; lib/account_display never echoes an account number; the TS map mirrors the config;
overview movers, risk positions and journal trades carry account_id + account_label; Home do-now names accounts and
one account's stop never hides another's unprotected shares; CIO cards keep every account. Hermetic: no DB, no server.
